name: Venus
defines: What you value and how you love — your taste, what draws you to people, and the way you show affection.

aries.definition: You love directly and at speed. Attraction is immediate for you, and the pursuit is a real part of the pleasure.
aries.showsUp: You make the first move, you are put off by hesitation, and you can lose interest once something stops feeling like an adventure.

taurus.definition: You love physically and durably. Venus rules this sign: affection means presence, touch, good food, and staying.
taurus.showsUp: You show love by feeding people and being reliably there, you have settled taste rather than fashionable taste, and you are very hard to dislodge once attached.

gemini.definition: You love through conversation. Someone becomes attractive to you when they are interesting, and stops being attractive when they are not.
gemini.showsUp: You flirt by talking, you need a partner you can think out loud with, and you go cold on anyone who bores you however kind they are.

cancer.definition: You love protectively. Affection means looking after someone and being let close enough to be looked after in return.
cancer.showsUp: You nurture the people you love and remember every anniversary, you take a long time to open up, and you take withdrawal harder than conflict.

leo.definition: You love generously and want it visible. Being chosen openly, and choosing openly in return, is the point for you.
leo.showsUp: You are lavish with gifts and compliments, you want romance to have some occasion to it, and you are wounded by affection that stays private.

virgo.definition: You love through care and attention. You show it by noticing what someone needs and quietly handling it.
virgo.showsUp: You do the practical thing rather than say the sweeping thing, you are slow to commit and thorough once you have, and you can criticise where you meant to help.

libra.definition: You love partnership itself. Venus rules this sign too: you are drawn to grace, fairness and the pleasure of being properly matched.
libra.showsUp: You are charming and easy to be around, you dislike ugliness in surroundings and in behaviour, and you will bend a long way to keep the peace.

scorpio.definition: You love completely or not at all. Intimacy for you means being fully known, which is exactly why you are careful about who you let in.
scorpio.showsUp: You are intensely loyal, you find surface friendliness unsatisfying, and you feel jealousy more strongly than you would like to.

sagittarius.definition: You love in motion. You are drawn to people who expand your world, and you need a relationship to leave room in it.
sagittarius.showsUp: You fall for someone's outlook before their circumstances, you resist anything that feels like being fenced in, and you are affectionate and blunt in equal measure.

capricorn.definition: You love seriously. Affection is something you demonstrate over years rather than declare, and you want a relationship to be built, not just felt.
capricorn.showsUp: You are reserved early and steady long-term, you show love by taking on responsibility, and you are quietly embarrassed by grand gestures.

aquarius.definition: You love as a friend first. Equality and independence matter more to you than intensity, and you resist the conventional shape of relationships.
aquarius.showsUp: You need friendship inside the romance, you keep some part of yourself separate on principle, and you are drawn to people who are unlike everyone else.

pisces.definition: You love without much of a boundary. Compassion and romance run together for you, and you are drawn to whatever moves you.
pisces.showsUp: You give more than is asked, you idealise people early and see them clearly late, and you are moved by beauty and by music almost physically.
